Commentary.Commentary: Bangladesh started really well with the ball as they managed to keep picking up wickets at regular intervals. The visitors will no doubt be disappointed with how things ended up as they allowed the last 4 wickets to pile up around 80 runs to cross the 250-run mark. They will be hoping that their batsmen get them off a good start. Remains to be seen how it all unfolds. Join us in a short while for the second innings.

Broom has rescued the Kiwis from what would have been a terrible performance. It has been his day as he hasn't put a foot wrong ever since he came out to bat. He also managed to reach his maiden ODI hundred at such a crucial time when none of the other players contributed much to that total. They will be happy going in the dressing room as the momentum has shifted back in their favour. The hosts will have to bowl well so that they can impose some pressure on the visitors. Some quick wickets and the the away side will be really feeling it.
